services.name: Sunset Experience
services.desc: Experience Lake Havasu’s Original Sunset Cruise - our signature 3-hour excursion aboard Serenity Now. Our Sunset Experience is our signature excursion and what we are known for. It is Lake Havasu’s original sunset cruise - a 3-hour journey aboard Serenity Now, created for passengers who want to experience Lake Havasu, Copper Canyon, and the Colorado River in a way that is scenic, peaceful, personal, and unforgettable. This is not a standard Lake Havasu boat tour. Everything about this excursion is designed around the changing light, the scenery, the music, the history, and the quiet magic that happens as Lake Havasu turns from day to night. Serenity Now is a one-of-a-kind custom pontoon

blurb: Guests experience scenic boat tours featuring local history, music, and signature routes including Copper Canyon, Topock Gorge, island shoreline, replica lighthouses, and the London Bridge story. Tours range from 60 minutes to 4 hours and include narration and onboard amenities. Private charters are available for groups and special occasions.
